rules.title: No narration labels over results
rules.text: A result in this repository is a table row or a plain sentence. An italic or bold label (`*Verified:*`, `*Cost:*`, `*Gate:*`) is narration: the fact reads the same without it, and the label implies a structure the document does not have.

judgement.question: Is this line a narration label introducing a result, rather than the result itself stated as a sentence or a table row?

criteria.true: it labels the text that follows instead of stating it, and the document would mean the same without the label
criteria.false: it is a defined term, a heading that carries content, or part of a quotation
